Papers where I am [first author]{.role-label .role-first} or [last author]{.role-label .role-last} are marked, including joint first and joint last authorship.

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("R/publications.R")
groups <- pub_groups(read_publications())
for (heading in names(groups)) {
  cat("\n## ", heading, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(pub_list_html(groups[[heading]]), "\n")
}
```
